name: Products without a supplier
title: Products without a supplier
help_text: Active products on no price list linked to a supplier. They have no lead time, so their stock cover goes ungraded and purchase planning leaves them out. A product's suppliers come from its price lists: link the list it is on to its supplier under Inventory → Suppliers → Supplier price lists, or add the product to a supplier's price list in Zoho and sync.
